channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Tiago Splitter | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Tiago Splitter from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Josh Giddey on Tiago Splitter
item.description:
Josh Giddey on Tiago Splitter:

“Yeah, he’s been great. He’s been really good, and I think as a guy that’s a former player in the NBA, he understands it, and he obviously did a great job with Portland last year. I’m super excited. I’ve had a lot of conversations with him. Obviously, he was in Portland last year, so I didn’t know him a lot, but since he’s been in Chicago, I’ve gotten to know him and spend time with him and talk with him.“Everything he’s about kind of aligns with how we want to play and go about things. He’s been great, and the conversations I’ve had with him have been great. I’m super excited to play for him and ramp things up as we get closer to the season.”

Josh Giddey on Tiago Splitter, Sep 3, 2026. Source: casino.org.

item.title: Dailyn Swain on Tiago Splitter
item.description:
K.C. Johnson:Dailyn Swain on Tiago Splitter:

“He’s always intense, passionate about the game. He was a player, so he did all this stuff before. He was always motivating, never like ‘C’mon guys.’You can see how much he loves the game, so it was easy to give your all for a coach like that.”

Dailyn Swain on Tiago Splitter, Jul 11, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Bryson Graham on Tiago Splitter
item.description:
Bryson Graham on Tiago Splitter:

“He's smart. He's curious as a coach in a game that is always changing. He wants to get better. He has the right level of competitiveness. He's a good communicator and connector.”

Bryson Graham on Tiago Splitter, Jun 17, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Damian Lillard on Tiago Splitter
item.description:
Damian Lillard on Tiago Splitter:

“I thought he did well. Being launched into that seat out of nowhere, unexpected, having to be a leader of men in this league is tough. Having to deal with minutes and managing personalities and rotations is tough. He did a great job on the fly.”

Damian Lillard on Tiago Splitter, Apr 30, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Deni Avdija on Tiago Splitter
item.description:
Deni Avdija on Tiago Splitter:

“Ithink Tiago did a great job. He got thrown in not an easy situation. He did a great job of connecting this group and getting the best out of all of us. Credit to the assistants, too. I definitely love Tiago and love playing for him.”

Deni Avdija on Tiago Splitter, Apr 30, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Robert Williams III on Tiago Splitter
item.description:
Robert Williams III on Tiago Splitter:

“He came in aggressively and we needed that. He let us know nobody is gonna feel sorry for us. I think he did such a great job coaching us and motivating us and letting us know he was in it with us. We were ready to go to war with him.”

Robert Williams III on Tiago Splitter, Apr 30, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Scoot Henderson on Tiago Splitter
item.description:
Scoot Henderson on Tiago Splitter:

“He was amazing. Having to be put in that role and lead a team to the playoffs, it was special that a former player took that role and didn't second-guess it. He stepped up and put his chest out.”

Scoot Henderson on Tiago Splitter, Apr 30, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Donovan Clingan on Tiago Splitter
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Donovan Clingan on Tiago Splitter:

“I love Tiago. He's a player's coach, he understands the game, he's won at high levels. He never took any shortcuts or took it easy on us. He showed up every day at his best and I'll always appreciate him for that.”

Donovan Clingan on Tiago Splitter, Apr 29, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: LeBron James on Tiago Splitter
item.description:
Tom Haberstroh:LeBron on the Splitter block:

“Basically, I told myself, 'You're going to end up on SportsCenter one way or another.'”

LeBron James on Tiago Splitter, Jun 10, 2013. Source: Twitter @tomhaberstroh.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Tiago Splitter
item.description:
Gregg Popovich:

“There's been no progression with Splitter. People have asked me that before - how did he get like this, what did he do during the summer... This is who he is. He's just been hurt most of the time he's been with us. This is the first time he's gotten consistent minutes. What you're seeing doing now is what he's been doing in Europe for years and years. He's played in championship teams with great coaches over there. This is what he does.”

Gregg Popovich on Tiago Splitter, Jan 26, 2013. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Manu Ginobili on Tiago Splitter
item.description:
Manu Ginobili on Splitter:

“It's not that he's improved. He's just used to the league. Different system, different way of calling fouls, defenders... Before he was a great player, and now Pop trusts thim, he understands the game, he can pass, he can finish... He's been a great addition to the team the last two years.”

Manu Ginobili on Tiago Splitter, Jan 26, 2013. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Tiago Splitter
item.description:
Scott Brooks on the Hack-A-Splitter strategy:

“It changed the tempo a bit. I mean, they were fast tonight. The ball was just all over the floor with quick passes, passes that were right in their shooting pockets, and it kind of threw their rhythm out a little. He stepped up and made [five] of them. He did better than his playoff percentage. But if on occasion we have an opportunity to do it again, we will.”

Scott Brooks on Tiago Splitter, May 30, 2012. Source: Sulia.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Tiago Splitter
item.description:
Jeff McDonald:Pop on Splitter:

“He’s a really, solid player who’s going to have a great NBA career, but he’s not going to lead us in scoring.”

Gregg Popovich on Tiago Splitter, Sep 16, 2010. Source: Twitter.
